none: PAS BERK-1271A1: Kintbury: Roman weight with owner's stamp
contea di ritrovamento: West Berkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A sub-circular lead alloy Roman weight, measuring 37.61mm long, 34.72mm wide, 15.71mm thick and weighing 148.6gms. The weight is stamped with two horizontal panels that contain the inscription QEM__NVS / QIMINVS – possibly the name of the owner / merchant. The weight has then been rotated 180° and the panels stamped again. The ‘S’ in the inscriptions is reversed. A small hole has been drilled in…
